svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Front Raise, Setup: Hold one dumbbell in front of your thigh with your palm toward you.
svg.title: Dumbbell Front Raise, Setup: Hold one dumbbell in front of your thigh with your palm toward you.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Front Raise, Raise: Lift the dumbbell forward with a slight bend in the elbow.
svg.title: Dumbbell Front Raise, Raise: Lift the dumbbell forward with a slight bend in the elbow.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Front Raise, Shoulder: Stop at shoulder height without leaning back.
svg.title: Dumbbell Front Raise, Shoulder: Stop at shoulder height without leaning back.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Front Raise, Lower: Lower slowly, then repeat on the other side.
svg.title: Dumbbell Front Raise, Lower: Lower slowly, then repeat on the other side.
